verdict.rationale: Plausible publishes a first-party self-hosting guide for Plausible Community Edition on GitHub, and community members confirm running it themselves for years and value it as FOSS they could keep maintaining. One user found self-hosting heavier than expected because it requires ClickHouse, which is an operational caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of CE system requirements and setup steps, and evidence on feature parity between Community Edition and the cloud product.
